title: VR training
body: Immersive procedure trainers where the simulation has to match reality exactly — the same sequence, the same consequences, the same muscle memory as the real task.

title: AR guidance
body: On-site overlays that put the right information on the real world: hidden infrastructure, assembly steps, inspection prompts — legible through gloves, glare and noise.

title: Digital twins
body: Spatial models wired to real data. Built on open government geodata — 3DBAG buildings, real attributes — so what a stakeholder sees is their own world, not a generic demo.
